items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 28:1
items.html: When ZON are in Katnut, light is drawn to them from the posterior of Ima, which detains the light of Hochma by force of “for He desires mercy,” as is known. And this posterior is called a wall, since it is a discernment of a wall and a screen that detain the illumination of Hochma. (p. 649, Item 53)
